evidence: empty_void: seg3:end (t=39.08s) is over half empty — two hairline rules, two thumbnail-sized mascots and a dotted ruler pinned to the right edge; seg4:start→payoff@-0.4 (42.49–47.07s) keeps that same vacant mid-frame under the closing panel.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: From seg4:start (42.49s) to payoff@-0.4 (47.07s) the frame is a bordered blue panel at the top, a full-width band of vacant gradient through the middle, the human-scale diagram shrunk to two ~40px mascots on hairlines, and CTA text overprinting the foreground mascot's face; nothing but a tiny mascot step changes across those 4.6 seconds.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing beat reuses the seg3 scale diagram at its shrunken end-state scale while stacking a bordered text panel above it, so the payoff has no subject of its own — the 22.3m cube the whole script builds to is never actually drawn as a cube, and the leftover diagram cannot fill the frame it was scaled out of.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make seg4 a real payoff shot: draw the 22.3m gold cube full-bleed as the subject (mascot at its base for scale so the '22.3m' reads physically), drop the bordered panel for full-bleed closing type on look.ground, and move the CTA line clear of the mascot so no text overprints a figure.
